title: Write smoke tests for the psp-etl analyze CLI command (issue L23). Augment tests/test_cli_analyze.py. Read the existing file first. Add: (1) a pipeline smoke test: create a blob with real printable ASCII content (e.g. b'spiRead() ERROR: bad value format_string=%s descriptive string here' * 10), run analyze, verify score > 0 and strings table populated. (2) verify 'Analyzed N unique blob(s).' appears in output. (3) verify --reanalyze flag actually overwrites stale scores (set score=999, reanalyze, confirm score \!= 999). Run uv run --extra dev pytest tests/ -q to confirm all tests pass. Commit and close issue L23.
